content: {"episode_id":"ep-05165","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), for which authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management."}
